subject: BrightWire pilot: MAP studio draft & demo cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carly Benson <carly@brightwire.ai>, Tom Liu <tom@brightwire.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWire pilot: MAP studio draft & demo cadence

Hi Carly / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our sync, I sketched an initial MAP in a shared GDoc that focuses the pilot on three fast validation metrics (latency-to-inference, throughput under 90% traffic, and prompt-quality regression on your sample dataset).

Links attached below are stubs for the working doc + a one-slide demo cadence I put together. Key asks from our side to finalize the MAP this week:
- Confirm the list of BrightWire stakeholders (engineering, security, product) and preferred weekly sync cadence
- Pick the 30-day pilot start window (we proposed Aug 24–Sep 21) or suggest alternatives
- Share any compliance docs we should include in the MAP (retention, PII handling)

I attached: MAP-template-studio-v1.gdoc (editable), pilot-demo-cadence-1slide.gslides. I can host a 30-min co-edit session to walk through the GDoc and lock owners. Suggested time: Thu 8/13 10:30–11:00 PT.

Next steps: if you confirm stakeholders and the start window we will: 1) lock owners in the GDoc, 2) add acceptance criteria + metric check-ins by week, and 3) schedule the demo cadence with your team.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP-template-studio-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), pilot-demo-cadence-1slide.gslides (Slides stub)

From: Carly Benson <carly@brightwire.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom@brightwire.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWire pilot: MAP studio draft & demo cadence

Marissa —

Thanks for the draft, and this looks like a good starting point. A few quick notes from our side:
- Stakeholders: please add Sarah Huang (Head of Product, sarah.huang@brightwire.ai), and cc our compliance lead, Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@brightwire.ai). Tom will stay engaged on the infra side.
- Timing: the proposed window (Aug 24–Sep 21) should work for engineering, but we need to confirm legal review timing (likely a 7–10 day review). Can we shift the proposed start to Aug 31 if legal isn't ready by the 24th?
- Acceptance criteria: we need a lightweight definition for prompt-quality. Can you propose a simple test suite (5–8 prompts) we can run and score?

Happy to join the co-edit session — Thu 8/13 10:30 PT works for Tom and me. If you prefer an earlier sync with legal included, let me know and I can loop Diego.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightWire pilot: MAP studio draft & demo cadence — internal notes

Marissa / Jonas —

Forwarding Carly's reply with a few internal notes before the co-edit:

1) Stakeholders — Marissa, please add Sarah and Diego to the GDoc and mark them as owners for acceptance criteria and compliance checklist respectively.
2) Pilot metrics — I recommend we propose a 6-prompt sample for the prompt-quality test (diverse intents + edge cases). We should include an automated scoring rubric (exact match/intent-pass/acceptable-response) so BrightWire can reproduce locally.
3) Legal timing — flag for operations: if legal pushes past Aug 28, propose Aug 31 start and communicate the contingency in the MAP.
4) Demo cadence — keep the first demo internal (Redwood/BrightWire eng) and the second demo a joint product review for stakeholders.

I'll prep a short suggested rubric and a sheet of owners in the GDoc before our co-edit this afternoon. Jonas, can you drop a couple of resource links (example eval harness + sample prompt set) into the doc?

Ben Carter
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Carly Benson <carly@brightwire.ai>, Tom Liu <tom@brightwire.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWire pilot: MAP studio draft & demo cadence

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turn. I added a compact 6-prompt suite and an automated scoring rubric into the GDoc (see link above). The rubric includes three checks per prompt: relevance, hallucination score, and latency bucket. For transparency I added a note on acceptance thresholds (we suggested: relevance >= 0.8, hallucination <= 0.05, p50 latency < 350ms at 50 concurrent RPS).

I've also created two short resource stubs in the doc: 
- eval-harness-example.zip (reference)
- sample-prompts.csv

Carly — I marked Sarah as an acceptance owner and Diego as the compliance reviewer. One ask: when you have a moment, can you confirm whether BrightWire can run the sample-prompts.csv behind their VPC or if they'd prefer Redwood to run them in a mirrored environment? That will change how we capture logs for the acceptance check.

Looking forward to the co-edit on Thu — sending a calendar update now.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
